record.name: Cambodia
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. The Ministry of Post and Telecommunications is drafting a national AI strategy (2025 to 2030) and no AI safety or testing body is named in the ministry's own pages.

related_bodies.name: Ministry of Post and Telecommunications (MPTC)
related_bodies.role: It leads the drafting of the National AI Strategy with UN-ESCAP support.

next_check.reason: Whether a national AI strategy or any national AI evaluation body is adopted.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. English search found a new official procurement notice for the National AI and Data Science Research Centre. The retrieved notice describes sovereign computing, talent and ethical AI innovation, not evaluation of advanced models for severe risks. This is a research-infrastructure development, not sufficient for an AISI status change. The retrieved procurement source is kh-r4-ai-research-centre-procurement. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.

check.language_note: The recorded km query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Indexed results were sparse or noisy; the recorded language search does not establish complete coverage. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: The ISEAS multi-country strategy sentence supplies general policy context, not substantive Cambodian institute-status evidence. Confidence was low under that rule; none_identified is a bounded search finding, not proof of absence.
check.governance_note: MPTC identifies itself as lead ministry for the draft national AI strategy and describes the drafting process; subsequent adoption was not verified.

record.notes: Latest primary sources are from April and May 2025 and show the strategy still in draft; later press reports suggest adoption was still pending in mid-2026, but no adoption document was found. Khmer-language and English searches.
